headline: Weight Surgery round 2: the step-3 scalpel is built while step-1 rows still bleed
lede: #1533's 32K scoring marathon is half-done on the GPU; meanwhile the next two steps went from sketch to proven tooling — and the demo page finally shows ROUND 2.

notes.text: Pass R1's magnitude sketch replaced with real per-layer write directions d_L (unit-normalized [6,1024], smoke-proven on the actual model, layer dirs decorrelated) — the loop direction is now a number we own.
r2_edit.py + r2_run_step2.sh land step 3 as turnkey: top-K down_proj ablation (K=128 mirrors MIT's p50c), refuses to run before the frozen step-1 gate says PASS, unit-checked on synthetic tensors.
Committed demo page was stale — regenerated: ROUND 2 section + real fair-rescore numbers now live on the branch; ws2check 32/32, ws3check 13/13.
Sandbox lesson banked: this session's env can't do keychain TLS (gh is dead) — a curl-backed gh shim + local proxy carry every GitHub call; next lanes source /tmp/forge/netenv.sh.
